purpose: Test acquisition from naturally observed training errors, the unresolved method bottleneck after v5 all-correct training and the closed v6 interface family. One bounded matched-memory experiment, not baseline/tool tuning or a claimed continual-learning result.
hypothesis: Corrective raw training experiences transfer more useful information than the same number of already-correct experiences and improve held-out performance over no memory without losing baseline-correct cases.

selection.B: two-to-four-image comparison, B-eligible groups assigned first
selection.rule: Metadata-only seeded case grouping, one question per case, known canonical-image and source-URL exclusion; members freeze before labels are associated. Training/report groups disjoint. No selection set or report-guided updates.

training.controller: All32 training episodes use the same unmodified H0 empty state; complete all predictions before constructing banks. No self-training, generated rationale, additional inference, or reported-case feedback.
training.bank_construction: For each stage in frozen order, let k=min(2, number of valid incorrect training predictions, number of valid correct training predictions). Corrective bank takes first k errors; success bank first k successes. Equal count per stage, at most4 raw records per bank. Never replace a missing error with a correct example or resample. All32 interactions retained privately using HCL ExperienceMemory; each bank is an immutable subset.
training.insufficient_errors: Run and report the planned matrix even for empty banks; full acquisition signal additionally requires at least one matched error per stage. No new training cases to obtain errors.
training.representation: Both banks use the identical global lexical top2 raw-only retrieval and exact original-option-text rendering of historical attempt and feedback. No abstract/skill/anchor records. This common interface is fixed to isolate write-source quality, not adopted as a v6 winner; its independent efficacy was not established.
training.limits: Memory source correctness is training supervision. No tuning or success selection from report outcomes. Context counts are matched per stage; text content and length necessarily differ.

execution.report_order: A/B interleaved cases; rotate three arms by case index; fresh native Agent and MemorySaver per cell, never alias equal snapshots
execution.unchanged: Author six tools/defaults, system/question prompt, current images/options, two-turn workflow, exact final A-F scoring, subscription model and reasoning settings
execution.gold_boundary: Only32 training labels available before finalization; report labels read after all144 report predictions or irreversible termination. Retain all176 planned denominators, failure/not-run wrong.

analysis.primary: All arm A/B and pooled accuracy plus paired four-cell gain/loss and descriptive exact McNemar for H0 to success, H0 to corrective, success to corrective
analysis.acquisition_development_signal: All176 complete/valid, at least one selected training error in each stage, corrective net gain at least2/48 over H0 and at least2/48 over matched success, no loss of H0-correct cases, and nonnegative net gain versus success in each stage. This is a development acquisition signal, not sequential retention or clinical evidence.
secondary: all32 training accuracy and eligible/selected error counts per stage
actual memory writes, raw retrieval exposure and immutability
context lengths and tool surface quality
initial/final agreement including bare single-letter first outputs, with explicit parseable denominator
all calls, tokens, wall-clock and storage
analysis.decision: One fixed candidate bank per source arm. No post-hoc resizing, report reuse, baseline tuning or endless error-bank search. Positive acquisition requires a new frozen sequential learning/retention experiment; null closes this specific bank construction and preserves the negative result.

storage: Reuse all existing models/data/runtime read-only. Count v4+v5+v6+v7 aggregate, stop at45GB, strict50GB; neutral subprocess argv and pure-Python storage probes.
public_boundary: Source, protocol, aggregate and cost only; no cases, images, answers, question identifiers, memory contents, per-case predictions or credentials.
